name: Authorization Matrix Testing
description: Test each sensitive operation across relevant roles and ownership states to verify server-side authorization.
steps: Define roles and resource ownership states.
Attempt each operation with each authorized and unauthorized role.
Verify both HTTP response and resulting state.
signals: Sensitive data is returned to the wrong principal.

name: Object Ownership Testing
description: Verify that access to an object requires authorization for that specific object rather than only authentication.
steps: Create resources owned by each user.
Request each resource while authenticated as the other user.
signals: Different ownership IDs produce accessible data.

name: Parameterized Query Verification
description: Review application data-access code and verify that untrusted input is separated from query structure.
steps: Confirm use of parameterized queries or safe ORM APIs.
signals: String concatenation used to construct queries.

name: Authentication Event Audit
description: Review authentication events and controls to identify unexpected successful logins, weak session controls, and suspicious access patterns.
steps: Review successful and failed authentication events.
